data.title: Tom Lee Says AI Debt Concerns Are Rising, Keeps Bullish View on Nvidia and Related Assets
data.description: Tom Lee said concerns are rising over debt financing for AI infrastructure, but he argued that expanding growth industries do not rely entirely on equity capital. He said increased borrowing by AI companies does not mean their business models have failed or that a bubble is about to end badly. According to Odaily, Lee said AI will become the economy's third major growth engine and that investors often underestimate the long-term value and adoption speed of new technologies in their early stages. He said he remains positive on Nvidia, semiconductors, memory chips, and energy and power assets driven by expanding computing demand.

data.title: Samson Mow Says Blockstream Could Offer Bounty After Hacker Returns Stolen Funds
data.description: Bitcoin News posted on X that Samson Mow said Blockstream’s refusal to pay a ransom does not rule out offering a bounty if the hacker returns the remaining stolen funds. According to Odaily, Mow said the stolen funds belong to Liquid users, so Blockstream cannot negotiate over them, and any bounty would need to be handled as a separate and reasonable arrangement.

data.title: Hutchison Telecom Macau To End Mobile Services On December 1
data.description:
Macau Post and Telecommunications Bureau said it received an application from Hutchison Telephone (Macau), a unit of CK Hutchison Holdings, to give up its 4G mobile telecom licence and plans to end mobile communications services in Macau from December 1, according to Ming Pao.

The bureau said the move was a commercial decision made by the company based on its own operating conditions. To protect users' interests, it has asked Hutchison to draw up a complete transition plan and said it will closely supervise the exit process in accordance with the law to ensure a smooth handover of services.

data.title: GM Restores Apple CarPlay in Latest Infotainment System
data.description: General Motors Co. is integrating Apple Inc.’s CarPlay into its latest infotainment system, three years after removing the interface from its electric vehicles and upsetting some consumers, Bloomberg reported.

data.title: Company Plans Perpetual Preferred Share Offering Under MORE Ticker
data.description:
The company plans to issue perpetual preferred shares under the ticker MORE, targeting to raise 15 million to 25 million pounds, with a minimum fundraising size of 10 million pounds. According to Odaily, the shares will require support from three market makers for listing admission.

Holders will receive cumulative weekly dividends and liquidation priority, but no voting rights, and the company may redeem the shares. By mid-2026, SWC held 2,878 bitcoins, and after a capital reduction approved by the High Court, the company had 132.5 million pounds in distributable reserves available for payment.

data.title: JD Sports Appoints New North America CEO and Chief Marketing Officer
data.description: JD Sports Fashion Plc named new executives to lead North America and marketing as the sports retailer seeks to reverse soft sales and a prolonged stock-market slump, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Bitmine Immersion Shares Fall 3.73% as Ethereum Drops 1.5%
data.description: Bitmine Immersion shares fell 3.73% to $24.80 in premarket trading Tuesday as Ethereum declined 1.5% over the past 24 hours to $2,476.81. According to NS3.AI, Bitmine said its Ethereum holdings reached 5.96 million tokens. The company added that its total crypto, cash, marketable securities and other investments reached $15.8 billion.

data.title: Jiangtian Chemical Shareholder Plans To Cut Stake By Up To 4.3308 Million Shares
data.description: Jiangtian Chemical said on September 15 that Nantong Jiangshan Agrochemical & Chemicals Co., Ltd., a shareholder with more than 5% of the company, plans to sell up to 4.3308 million shares, or up to 3% of total share capital, over the three months starting 15 trading days after the announcement. The planned disposal includes up to 1.4436 million shares, or 1% of total share capital, via block trades and up to 2.8872 million shares, or 2%, via block trades. The shareholder cited its own funding needs and said the sale price will not be lower than Jiangtian Chemical's IPO price, according to Jiemian News. Based on the September 14 closing price of 27.3 yuan per share, the stake sale would have a maximum market value of about 118 million yuan.

data.title: White House Economic Adviser Hassett Says Trump Respects Any Decision Fed Chair Warsh Makes Tomorrow
data.description: White House National Economic Council Director Hassett said U.S. President Donald Trump and he respect any decision Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh makes tomorrow. According to Odaily, Hassett made the remarks on the eve of Warsh's decision.

data.title: Trump and Hassett Respect Any Decision Made by Fed Chair Kevin Warsh
data.description: U.S. President Donald Trump and White House National Economic Council Director Hassett respect any decision made by Fed Chair Kevin Warsh tomorrow, Hassett said. According to ChainCatcher, Hassett made the remarks about the Federal Reserve chair's upcoming decision.

data.title: Carlyle CEO Sees US Economy Holding Up as Fed Watches Data
data.description:
Carlyle Group CEO Harvey Schwartz said the US economy is “doing quite well” despite uncertainty and inflation, and said the Federal Reserve will keep watching the data, according to Bloomberg.

Schwartz also discussed Carlyle’s partnership with the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and his view on growth concerns tied to artificial intelligence.

data.title: Salesforce and Nvidia Launch KOA, a CRM Reasoning Model Built on NVIDIA NeMoTron
data.description: Salesforce and Nvidia have jointly launched KOA, described as the first CRM reasoning model built on NVIDIA NeMoTron. According to ChainCatcher, the model is positioned as a CRM-focused reasoning system based on Nvidia's NeMoTron framework.

data.title: Polymarket T1 Academy Game 4 First Blood Odds Jump to 50%
data.description: Polymarket odds for the "Game 4 First Blood" submarket in the "LoL T1 Academy vs KT Rolster Challengers LCK playoffs" event swung sharply, with the "T1 Academy" option rising from 25.5% an hour earlier to 50%. According to ChainCatcher, the move reflected a 24.5 percentage point increase and may have been affected by breaking news.

data.title: Caesar Travel Says Wholly Owned Subsidiary Suspected Of RMB 26.95 Million Contract Fraud
data.description:
Caesar Travel (Shenzhen: 000796) said its wholly owned subsidiary Caesar Tongsheng Cultural Industry Development (Beijing) is suspected of contract fraud involving RMB 26.95 million, according to Ming Pao.

The company said the case involves Caesar Tongsheng Cultural Industry Development (Beijing), its wholly owned subsidiary.

data.title: White House CEA to Launch Stablecoin Simulation Tool on Tuesday
data.description:
The White House Council of Economic Advisers will launch an interactive tool on Tuesday that lets users set parameters and run scenarios to support its conclusion that there is no material link between stablecoin growth and community bank deposit outflows. According to ChainCatcher, the move is aimed at helping Senate Republicans advance the CLARITY Act while addressing banking groups that said Monday the latest revisions still do not ease their concerns about stablecoin provisions.

Several Republican senators have signaled they may vote against the bill, while pro-crypto Democrats remain dissatisfied that the ethics provisions do not sufficiently constrain U.S. President Donald Trump. The bill needs at least 60 votes to advance.

data.title: Standard Chartered Sees Tokenized Stock Market Growing 250-Fold by 2028
data.description:
Standard Chartered said the tokenized stock market is expected to grow about 250-fold by 2028. According to Odaily, the bank said Arbitrum's business model could help traditional financial institutions move assets and operations onchain and benefit from the growth of tokenized stocks and other real-world assets.

As of early September, the tokenized stock market was worth about $2.9 billion and had become one of the faster-growing asset classes in the real-world assets sector.

data.title: Brightshore Capital Starts $250 Million Property Debt Platform
data.description:
Brightshore Capital, formerly GTIS Partners, has launched its first real estate debt investment platform with $250 million in initial capital, according to Bloomberg.

The global real estate firm said the platform comes as homebuilders’ financing needs are mounting.

data.title: Gold, Bitcoin Bets Diverge as Debasement Trade Splits
data.description: With Treasuries sinking and the dollar falling this year, Bitcoin and gold are again being touted as hedges against currency debasement, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Radiant World, Sapphire Minmetals Trim Staff as Fraud Allegations Grow
data.description:
Radiant World and Sapphire Minmetals have made further job cuts across their offices in Asia and Europe as allegations of fraud mount, according to people familiar with the matter.

Bloomberg reported the two iron ore traders are under pressure amid the legal challenges.

data.title: Seres and Huawei to Shift Aito Cooperation Toward Seres-Led Operations
data.description:
Seres and Huawei will adjust their Aito smart-car partnership this week, with product, marketing, sales and service shifting from Huawei-led to Seres-led operations while Huawei provides support, according to Jiemian News. The report said Harmony Intelligent Mobility Alliance will direct more resources to Luxeed, Stelato, Maextro and Shangjie.

The change would give Seres more control over Aito pricing, technology procurement and service spending. Jiemian News said Seres has already been preparing for a more flexible, asset-light model through new projects such as AIVA, where Seres subsidiary Saidu Technology has worked with Volcano Engine on large-model and smart-cockpit technology.

Seres reported revenue of 57.493 billion yuan in the first half of 2026, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of 1.717 billion yuan. Sales expenses were 8.471 billion yuan and R&D spending was 3.734 billion yuan. The company said impairment charges reduced net profit attributable to shareholders by about 1.751 billion yuan, as revenue from existing models fell short of expectations amid technology upgrades.

Jiemian News said Seres has been paying both for Huawei's technology and services and for its own R&D and distribution network. Under the new arrangement, Seres may buy more functions on demand, including intelligent driving, smart-cockpit systems and sales services, while keeping more of the related decision-making in-house.
